mapper.select: select file_id as id, file_path as path from oa_file where file_id > #{afterId} and file_path like '/profile/%' and (biz_type is null or biz_type <> 'import_error') order by file_id asc limit #{limit}

select file_id as id, file_path as path from oa_file where file_id > #{afterId} and file_path is not null and file_path <> '' and file_path not like '/profile/%' and file_path not like 'http%' and (biz_type is null or biz_type <> 'import_error') order by file_id asc limit #{limit}
select count(1) from oa_file where file_path like '/profile/%' and (biz_type is null or biz_type <> 'import_error')
select count(1) from sys_user where avatar like '/profile/%'
select count(1) from oa_file where file_path is not null and file_path <> '' and file_path not like '/profile/%' and file_path not like 'http%' and (biz_type is null or biz_type <> 'import_error')
select count(1) from sys_user where avatar like '/common/attach/%'
